program.section_heading: Theatre Arts Associate of Arts Degree for Transfer (AA-T)
outcomes: To analyze, dissect, and critically evaluate a script or theatrical event or film with working knowledge of its historical, cultural, and societal origins and contexts.

To use strongly developed physical, vocal, and emotional foundations to build a personalized acting process for approaching a text or character in order to effectively communicate on stage or in film.
To describe the process and be able to write, produce, direct, manage, promote, and star in a theatrical event or film.
To be academically and fundamentally prepared to enter the entertainment industry or transfer to a four-year acting or film program with an advanced standing.
